# CommonMark 0.31.2 corpus

`commonmark_0.31.2.json` contains the 652 Markdown/HTML examples from the
CommonMark 0.31.2 specification test corpus. The source is the official
`spec.json` published with [CommonMark 0.31.2](https://spec.commonmark.org/0.31.2/).
